findings.text: the corrected slope/r table reports six loops (FL7, FL15, FL20, FL23, FL26, FL27) but only four probes (MP1, MP5, MP13, MP17), short of the done-when's "the corrected prediction-versus-measurement slope and Pearson r for at least five loops and five probes after applying them"; the across-shots table adds only MP1 and MP5, already counted, so no fifth probe carries a corrected slope anywhere in the fragment although rca_checks.log carries all 17 probes corrected.

Check 2 reports the pre-pulse baseline and drift of seven loops (FL1, FL6, FL7, FL15, FL20, FL26, FL27) and four probes (MP1, MP5, MP13, MP17), not "each raw loop's pre-pulse baseline and drift" of the 27 loops the done-when names; the ruling-out argument generalises from the seven-loop sample.
